description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the FileHandle extension methods related to safe reading operations, particularly handling closed handles and incremental reading from pipes.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct representing a suite of tests for safe reading from file handles, focusing on behavior with closed handles and data reading correctness.

methods.name: `read to end safely returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Tests that reading to end from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: `read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle`
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a count from a closed handle returns empty data.

methods.name: `read to end safely reads pipe contents`
methods.description: Tests that reading all data safely from a pipe containing data returns the correct string.

methods.name: `read safely up to count reads incrementally`
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a count incrementally yields the expected segmented data.
